prepare_tabular_binary_classification: create a tabular binary classification dataset by splitting train data and pushing to Hugging Face Hub
prepare_tabular_multiclass_classificatio: create a tabular multiclass classification dataset using the same preprocessing as binary classification
prepare_tabular_regression: create a tabular single column regression dataset without stratified splitting for continuous targets
prepare_tabular_multilabel_classificatio: create a tabular multi-label classification dataset with multiple label columns and indexed label names
prepare_tabular_multicolumn_regression: create a tabular multi-column regression dataset using the same preprocessing as multi-label classification
